### **Average teacher salary (A.R.S. §15-189.05)**

Average salary of all teachers employed in the budget year 2027: $44,480  
Average salary of all teachers employed in the prior year 2026: $43,472  
Increase in average teacher salary from the prior year 2026 $1,008. Percentage increase: 2.3%

The average salary calculation does not distinguish between new employees and long-term employees’ tenure at the school results in higher earnings.
